default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-001.title: VWAP reclaim
E-001.hypothesis: After the price stays on one side of the session VWAP for a while, the first close back across it marks a change of control; follow the cross.

E-002.title: Previous-day high/low rejection
E-002.hypothesis: Trading beyond the previous session's high/low and closing back inside it is a failed auction at a level many participants watch; fade it.

E-003.title: Previous-day high/low breakout
E-003.hypothesis: A close beyond the previous session's high/low triggers stops and breakout orders; follow it.

E-004.title: Trend-day pullback to the EMA
E-004.hypothesis: On a day already moving more than usual for the time of day, the first pullback to a short EMA that closes back on the trend side is a continuation entry.

E-005.title: Inside-bar breakout
E-005.hypothesis: A bar inside the previous one compresses the range; a close beyond it releases it in that direction.

E-006.title: Opening-range failure
E-006.hypothesis: When the price breaks the opening range and then closes back inside it, the breakout traders are trapped; fade back into the range.

E-007.title: Quiet continuation
E-007.hypothesis: After a large move, a bar in the move's direction on LOW volume means nobody is pushing back; follow.

E-008.title: Midday extreme fade
E-008.hypothesis: Between 12:00 and 14:30 liquidity is thinner and breaks of the recent high/low tend to fail; fade a bar that pokes beyond and closes back inside.
